title: SD1 NEU Semi tVS-E
wikitext:
[[Image:SD EU.gif|right|SD EU Logo]] == Introduction == * Competition: [[SD NEU Season 1|Smackdown North Europe 1]] * Round: Semifinals * Match: [[The Viper Squad]] vs [[Euthanasia]] * Date: 14-10-2000 == Screenshots == === DM3 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Semi_tVS-E_dm3.jpg]]

[E]'s choice was dm3, and would be played first on a Swedish server, giving them a ping advantage of 4-10ms!! The game started well for TVS who got a small lead until E fought back and got some controls, which they never really lost. Dm3 ended 176-105 in Euthanasia favour. === DM2 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Semi_tVS-E_dm2.jpg]]

The server was changed to play TVS' map, being dm2. The Finish server gave little ping advantage to TVS, not much more than E had in game1. I think E got the better start, got both RLs and quad if i remember correctly. TVS hit back soon though and controlled the map for about 5 minutes in which they gained many frags. From then on, the game continued very chaotically, no team seeming to be in a great advantage. From TVS' POV it was enough to get the game home to Finland 201-142. === DM6 === [[Image:SD1_NEU_Semi_tVS-E_dm6.jpg]]

Last map has been chosen by mr peace (the bot), who wanted to see a game on dm6. It was played on Get2net (Denmark) which was the fairest server of the day. Average pings between 32 and 36 to both teams. The game started pretty boring, with E taking an early lead but TVS controlling RA, for almost the whole game. E lead about 15 minutes and then TVS took over. E ran behind which isn't that easy when you are back and don't control RA on dm6. E managed to win anyway, with an amazing last minute, this game really has been decided in the last minute ending 311-296. Good game to both teams.
